GAME INFORMATION

A few things
worth knowing.

The essentials about Eclipsed Realms, playing together and finding your way around.

What is Eclipsed Realms?

A dark fantasy action RPG about exploration, physical combat, powerful magic and personal choices. Travel through troubled communities, build relationships and decide where you stand.

When can I play?

Eclipsed Realms is in development. Release timing, supported platforms and where to buy the game have not been announced.

Can I play with friends?

The campaign supports up to four players, with up to two local players on each machine. Join over a local network or with a direct address.

Do we have to make the same choices?

No. Your answers, relationships and personal consequences belong to your character. The host’s choices determine what physically happens in the shared world.

Are Holy and Blood magic good and evil?

A school of magic does not decide your morality. Holy magic can cause harm, and Blood magic can protect. Your actions tell your story.

Will the guide spoil the story?

The main site introduces the world without revealing its endings. Quest details, character secrets and ending explanations stay behind an optional spoiler switch on World & story.

Where should I start with the guide?

Begin with How to play for combat, magic and exploration essentials. Use the Player guide when you want details on a particular spell, weapon, ability or game system.

Do I need to enter training to unlock fast travel?

No. Discover a Doll travel destination during your journey to make it available. The station at the old house opens after its attic story encounter.
